What Is Long-Distance Vehicle Recovery?

Long-distance vehicle recovery is the transportation of a vehicle over a longer journey rather than simply recovering it to a nearby garage.

For example, you may need your vehicle moved:

  • From Birmingham to another UK city
  • From another city back to Birmingham
  • From a breakdown location to your home
  • From a breakdown location to a garage
  • From a garage to another location
  • Between two different cities
  • To a buyer, seller or agreed destination

The distance and recovery requirements can vary from one job to another, so the best approach is to provide the collection and delivery locations when requesting a quote.

GOOD TO KNOW

When Do You Need Long-Distance Recovery?

There are several situations where driving the vehicle yourself may not be practical or possible.

Your Vehicle Has Broken Down Away From Home

A breakdown becomes more difficult when you are hundreds of miles from home. If the vehicle cannot be repaired at the roadside, long-distance recovery can provide a way to get the vehicle and, where appropriate, arrange its transportation to a suitable destination.

Your Car Cannot Be Driven

Mechanical faults, accident damage or other problems can leave a vehicle unsafe or unable to continue its journey.

Instead of attempting to drive a damaged or non-running vehicle, professional recovery can be arranged to transport it.

You Need to Take Your Vehicle to a Specialist Garage

Sometimes the nearest garage may not be the right place for a particular repair. You may want your vehicle taken to a trusted mechanic, specialist workshop or another garage in a different city.

Long-distance vehicle recovery can help with this type of transportation.

You Have Purchased a Vehicle in Another City

Buying a vehicle from another part of the UK does not always mean you can drive it home. The vehicle may be non-running, untaxed, awaiting repairs or otherwise unsuitable to drive.

A.A.D Transport & Recovery can discuss the collection and transportation requirements with you.

You Are Moving Your Vehicle to a New Location

If you are relocating or need a vehicle moved between cities, professional transportation can be a practical alternative to driving it yourself.

AT A GLANCE

Long-Distance Breakdown Recovery From Birmingham

A breakdown is particularly inconvenient when you are far away from home.

For example, you may break down while travelling from Birmingham to another part of the UK. If the vehicle cannot continue safely, you may need to decide whether to repair it locally or have it transported elsewhere.

A.A.D Transport & Recovery can discuss the available recovery and transportation options based on:

This helps ensure the recovery arrangement matches the actual situation rather than using the same solution for every vehicle.

  • Your current location
  • Your vehicle type
  • The condition of the vehicle
  • Your destination
  • The distance involved
  • Whether the vehicle can be driven

Long-distance vehicle recovery is the transportation of a vehicle over a longer journey rather than simply recovering it to a nearby garage.

For example, you may need your vehicle moved:

  • From Birmingham to another UK city
  • From another city back to Birmingham
  • From a breakdown location to your home
  • From a breakdown location to a garage
  • From a garage to another location
  • Between two different cities
  • To a buyer, seller or agreed destination

The distance and recovery requirements can vary from one job to another, so the best approach is to provide the collection and delivery locations when requesting a quote.

A vehicle does not necessarily need to be roadworthy or running to require transportation.

A non-running vehicle may need long-distance recovery because of:

  • Engine failure
  • Battery or electrical problems
  • Gearbox problems
  • Accident damage
  • Wheel or suspension damage
  • MOT-related issues
  • Mechanical faults
